game_mode_screen.title: Select a Game Mode
game_mode_screen.classic_description: Be the first to line up three of your symbols (X or O) in a line, which can be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal.
game_mode_screen.pyramid_description: In tic tac toe's Pyramid mode, players start on boards at the bottom of a pyramid and advance to higher boards as they win, making the game more challenging and fun.
game_mode_screen.5x5_description: 5x5 tic tac toe expands the classic board to 5x5 cells, where the goal is to line up four symbols in a row. This variation offers a more complex and strategic game.
game_mode_screen.ultimate_description: Tic Tac Toe Ultimate interconnects nine tic tac toe boards, where each move determines the next board to be played, adding a deep strategic layer to the game.
game_mode_screen.game_mode_message_opponent: Waiting for other player to select a Game Mode.
